name: COOKiES MS Dynamics 365 Marketing Anonymize
description: Provides anonymize callbacks for Dynamics 365 Forms with the COOKiES Consent Management cookie banner.
project_description: A COOKiES sub-integration that ties Microsoft Dynamics 365 Marketing's tracking anonymization to visitor cookie consent. It does not add, handle, or block any Dynamics 365 form/tracking code itself; its only job is to set or remove Dynamics 365's client-side "Anonymize" flag as documented by Microsoft. When consent is not given (the default) it declares a global d365mktConfigureTracking() returning {Anonymize: true}; when consent is granted it returns {Anonymize: false} and calls MsCrmMkt.reconfigureTracking({Anonymize: false}). The module registers a COOKiES service (id msdynamics365marketing) in the 'tracking' group and attaches a small JS behavior on every page that reacts to the COOKiES cookiesjsrUserConsent event. The maintainers flag it as very specific and work in progress. Requires the COOKiES (cookies) module.
